scheme_name: Financial Assistance on Death/Disablement of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
other_conditions: The beneficiary must be working in an establishment registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965 and must have regular contributions received by the Board.
In case of death of a registered male construction worker, the widowed dependent must apply within one year from the date of death.
The applicant must not have availed any financial assistance from any other Government body.
Disability benefits are limited to full or 50% disability caused by an accident.
benefits_summary: Ex‑gratia grant of ₹50,000 to widowed dependents of deceased workers, and disability grants of ₹25,000 for full disability or ₹15,000 for 50 % disability due to accident.
documents_required: Clear picture of both sides of the Aadhaar Card
Clear picture of the Bank Passbook
Clear picture of all pages of the BOCW Copy issued by the Board
